variables.name: STATE_NEW
variables.comment: * The engine is constructed, but the initial handshake hasn't been started

variables.name: STATE_MODE_SET
variables.comment: * The client/server mode of the engine has been set.

variables.name: STATE_HANDSHAKE_COMPLETED
variables.comment:
* Listeners of the handshake have been notified of completion but the handshake call
         * hasn't returned.

variables.name: STATE_READY_HANDSHAKE_CUT_THROUGH
variables.comment:
* The handshake call returned but the listeners have not yet been notified. This is expected
         * behaviour in cut-through mode, where SSL_do_handshake returns before the handshake is
         * complete. We can now start writing data to the socket.

variables.name: STATE_READY
variables.comment:
* The handshake call has returned and the listeners have been notified. Ready to begin
         * writing data.

variables.name: STATE_CLOSED_INBOUND
variables.comment: * The inbound direction of the engine has been closed.

variables.name: STATE_CLOSED_OUTBOUND
variables.comment: * The outbound direction of the engine has been closed.
